weather_line: Clearing fog on the ridge · mud on all wheels · the table waiting

stories.headline: They Are Home: the Jeep Returns at Half Past Two With Mud to Its Axles, a Second Circle on the Map, and Steve Already Talking About the Next One
body: The Jeep passed the end of the drive at fourteen twenty-eight, fog-dusted and trail-honest, its wheels carrying a thorough account of the day. The mud, sources confirm, represents at least two separate creek crossings, one extended ridge shelf, and a descent the Jeep appears to have found more interesting than the ascent. Steve was heard describing the descent in terms that suggested affection rather than concern. The Jeep, for its part, accepted the description without contradiction.

A second waymarker has been added to the ordnance chart in the same 2H pencil as the first, some four miles north-northeast of the original circle, at the head of a hollow that does not appear on the Ministry's standard-issue trail register. Steve has annotated it with three words. Christine has already looked up the access road. The map is back on the table.

The dogs met them at the door in order of enthusiasm: Ellie first, at speed, having apparently forgotten they had left and treating the return as an entirely unprecedented miracle; Jersey second, from the warmest available position, registering delight without sacrificing posture; Lucy last, from the hallway, offering a look that indicated she had managed the household without incident and expected this to be noted. It has been noted.

stories.headline: The Kitchen Table, Having Briefly Held Nothing at All, Receives the Map's Return With Quiet Satisfaction; the Second Circle Is Already Discussed
body: The table, which has passed through phases — ordnance chart, transitional coffee cup, bare surface, bare surface again — was restored to active service at fourteen thirty-one, when the map was unrolled across it and weighted at the corners with a compass, a mug, a trail guide, and one of Steve's work gloves.

The second circle sits north-northeast, pencilled in the same confident hand as the first, with a margin note that three separate household members have now read without being invited to. The access road question has been settled. The departure window, sources suggest, is not this weekend but is not far beyond it either. The table appears to have known something was coming all along.

stories.headline: Household Governance Report Filed: Lucy's Administration Described as 'Unremarkable,' Which Is Not the Same as Uneventful; Evidence Pending
body: With Christine and Steve absent from first light through mid-afternoon, household authority devolved, as it customarily does, to whatever Lucy decided it was. An official report has not been issued. An official report was never going to be issued.

Inspection of the premises upon return revealed: one sofa cushion slightly repositioned, the kitchen bin lid at a non-standard angle, and a small quantity of something on the garage step that Ellie was standing near when discovered and could not explain, though she tried. Lucy was found in the armchair, apparently having been there for some time. The armchair is by the front window. From it, one has a clear view of the drive.

stories.headline: Ministry Issues Sunday Bulletin Confirming Sunday; Notes That the Jeep Has Returned 'Within the Parameters of a Weekend'; Considers This the Week's Most Successful Outcome
body: The Ministry of Magic's Sunday communication, distributed at three o'clock, confirmed that Sunday had occurred and that the Jeep's return constituted, in the Ministry's assessment, 'a satisfactory resolution to a departure event it had been monitoring since six forty-one yesterday morning.' The Ministry did not specify what action it had prepared in the event of an unsatisfactory resolution.

A footnote observed that the second circle on the chart had been 'logged for future reference.' A second footnote observed that the Ministry had not been shown the map. A third footnote, unsigned, read: 'We would like to see the map.' No response has been provided.

familiars_corner: Lucy: administered the household for eight hours and has submitted no incident report, which is her right, and also, she would like it known, her preference.
Ellie: was absolutely certain, when the Jeep came up the drive, that it was the first time she had ever seen a Jeep, and her joy was in proportion to this belief, which was total.
Jersey: relocated twice during the absence to optimize warmth, accepted the returning humans warmly but without abandoning his position, and considers the afternoon a success on multiple fronts.
founding_editor_note: Two circles on the same map means the project's got legs — that's how I knew a single garage wasn't going to be enough. Built a second one. Never regretted it. — D.

in_brief.sport: Sunday Training Log: the trail counts; the mud on the axles is doing its own accounting.
in_brief.forecast: Clear through Monday, with a high chance of the map being consulted again before supper; pack accordingly.

storyline_updates.title: The Table Awaits
storyline_updates.summary: Resolved Sunday afternoon. The Jeep returned at fourteen twenty-eight, mud to the axles, with a second waymarker pencilled north-northeast of the first. The dogs met them at the door. The map is back on the table. Christine has already researched the access road. Steve has three words written in the margin of the chart. The table, having hosted a goblin investigation, a transitional coffee cup, a bare surface, and now two expedition circles, appears settled. Arc closed warmly, with the exhale of a good return and the quiet hum of whatever comes next.

storyline_updates.title: The Second Circle
storyline_updates.summary: New arc, opening with the second waymarker pencilled on the ordnance chart at the head of an unnamed hollow, four miles north-northeast of the first. Steve's three-word margin note has not been fully disclosed. Christine has the access road. The Jeep's tank will need refilling. Day 2 should establish what the hollow is — a named local feature, a trail that someone else has mentioned, something spotted from the ridge today — and what additional preparation the table begins to accumulate. The departure window is not this weekend but is narrowing.
